data.name: Genesis
data.gender_notes: Genesis is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Genesis is recorded in name-lists as “Origin, beginning”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Genesis expresses “Origin, beginning”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Genesis total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
data.cultural_impact: Genesis is used in its naming tradition with the meaning “Origin, beginning”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Genesis is interpretive and is labelled as such.
